subject.title: fix(channels): prevent outbound echoes and expose native login

question: Should the new outbound-echo identity helpers remain a public plugin-SDK contract, or should the shared admission seam stay internal until a broader plugin API is designed?
rationale: The branch adds a new public SDK API rather than only repairing Discord internals, and repository policy treats plugin API direction as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Keep the SDK seam
options.body: Approve the public helpers after defining their supported identity, expiry, and compatibility guarantees and adding focused contract coverage.

options.title: Keep it internal
options.body: Use the shared registry for bundled channel code but remove the new public plugin-SDK exports until an external-plugin use case and contract are reviewed.

recommendation.title: Keep the SDK seam
recommendation.body: Approve the public helpers after defining their supported identity, expiry, and compatibility guarantees and adding focused contract coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied commit series is the available concrete ownership signal for the shared channel and SDK design.
